summary: Darwin Notify is a system-wide, name-keyed notification facility with integer tokens, state values and kernel-level delivery. BifrOSt has no equivalent: the nearest app-facing counterpart is the Foundation-style DistributedNotificationCenter, which relays string-named broadcasts between running apps through the shell. System event names (time zone, mounts, clock, network) are not broadcast to apps by name.

features.note: Cross-app broadcast relayed by the shell (ToShell::DistPost). Only between BifrOSt apps, string names, string user_info capped at 32 entries; no system-wide Darwin names.

features.feature: Registering a handler for a name (notify_register_dispatch)
features.note: Observers run on the main thread, not on a caller-chosen dispatch queue. Observer closures are tied to the main thread; no queue argument.
Wave 2 (theme-20, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No token API; delivery is push only.
No POSIX signal delivery for notifications.

Wave 2 (theme-20, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. fswatch exposes an fd for file-system events only; there is no fd for named notifications.
Mach ports are Apple-kernel IPC; Linux build has no equivalent.
Dropping the token removes the observer. No suspend or resume, and no integer token validity check.
Wave 2 (theme-20, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Nothing stores a 64-bit state alongside a name.

features.apple: notify_post delivery when target not running
features.note: An app that is not running misses the post, equal to Apple's drop behaviour, with no option to hold it.

features.feature: System event names (kNotifyTimeZoneChange, kNotifyClockSet, kNotifyVFSMount, kNotifyVFSUnmount, kNotifyVFSLowDiskSpace, kNotifySCNetworkChange, kNotifySCHostNameChange, kNotifyDSCacheInvalidation*, kNotifyASLDBUpdate)
features.note: Wave 2 (theme-20, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No shell broadcast for time zone, clock, mount, disk-space, network or host-name changes under these names. Workspace app-launch events exist but use their own message, not Darwin names.
Return codes of the Darwin C API; not applicable to the BifrOSt SDK.

gaps: No system-wide named notifications from the kernel or system services (time zone, clock, mount, network, disk space) to apps.
No notify_check, notify_register_signal, notify_set_state or notify_get_state equivalents.
No suspend or resume of observers, and no hold-for-later delivery to apps that are not running.
Observers always run on the main thread; no caller-chosen dispatch queue.
Broadcast payloads are string to string with a 32-entry and 1024-character cap per value.
